# Designs generated by LSD's own interface

Reference files for `tests/test_doe_gui_reference.py`.

Generated on 2026-10-01 with LSD 8.1 (tag `8.1-stable-5`, Linux arm64, g++ 13.3)
running in a Docker container, from the files in `baseline/`:

| Folder | LSD menu command (Data > Sensitivity Analysis) | Settings | Sensitivity file |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mc/` | MC Range Sampling | defaults (10 samples) | `Linear.sa` |
| `nolh/` | NOLH Sampling | defaults (table 7x17x33, not extended) | `Linear.sa` |
| `nolh_append/` | MC Range Sampling, offered by LSD after NOLH as the out-of-sample set, "Append" checked | 10 samples | `Linear.sa` |
| `ee/` | EE Sampling | defaults (10 trajectories, pool 100, 4 levels, jump 2) | `Linear.sa` |
| `full/` | Full (batch) | — | `Levels.sa` |

The files are exactly what LSD wrote. Do not edit them.
